title: Symmetry of the fixed boundary tensor pullback comparison
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be any morphism of schemes, $P=\mathrm{tensorPullback}(j)$, and $A,B$ arbitrary $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Write $\delta_{A,B}:P(A\otimes B)\simeq PA\otimes PB$ for boundaryPullbackTensorIso, obtained by transporting the fixed Mathlib pullback tensorator through boundaryPullbackComparison [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Then $P(\beta_{A,B})\gg\delta_{B,A}=\delta_{A,B}\gg\beta_{PA,PB}$, where $\beta$ is the sheaf tensor symmetry [lem-weil-pbc-module-tensor-symmetric-monoidal] and $\gg$ denotes composition in application order. No invertibility, immersion or square-zero assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses; canonical tensor comparisons from modules.tex, Tag 01CD (lemma-tensor-product-pullback), and Tag 01CA (section-tensor-product); read via the Stacks tag pages.

proof.text: For Mathlib pullback apply the injective pullback-pushforward adjunction hom equivalence to the symmetry square. Maps out of a sheaf tensor are determined by their values on tensor sections over all opens, by the sheafification adjunction and the presheaf tensor universal property.

Move the pullback of braiding across the adjunction unit by naturality. The braiding interchanges s and t, and the proved pullback cotensorator normalization sends the unit of their tensor to the tensor of their two units. Thus both adjoint maps send s tensor t to pullback(t) tensor pullback(s). The tensor universal property proves the square for Mathlib pullback.

Expand boundaryPullbackTensorIso. Naturality of boundaryPullbackComparison moves P of the original braiding to Mathlib pullback of it. Apply the square just proved, then naturality of braiding on the inverse component comparisons. This gives the displayed square.

theorem boundaryPullbackTensorIso_braiding {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    (A B : X.Modules) :
    (tensorPullback j).map (β_ A B).hom ≫ (boundaryPullbackTensorIso j B A).hom =
      (boundaryPullbackTensorIso j A B).hom ≫
        (β_ ((tensorPullback j).obj A) ((tensorPullback j).obj B)).hom
